name: Hanoi to Ninh Binh
summary: Ninh Binh is the easy overnight south of Hanoi. Train and road both take about two hours to the city; Tam Coc is a little farther.

modes.note: Regular trains stop at Ninh Binh. Then a taxi to Tam Coc.
Door to door if the car continues to your homestay.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Ninh Binh — train, bus, and car
seoDescription: How to get from Hanoi to Ninh Binh and on to Tam Coc.

faqs.q: Can you go and return the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Leave early, pick two sites, and expect a long day.
